method: Pure presentation contracts and native-touch phone engineering. Encounter suppression, isolated elevated platform, actor telegraphs/attack/last-hit times, damage and HUD composition are arranged. Real Game marker LOS/expiry and live renderer callbacks are used except one explicitly forced layout composition. Native input tests route orientation and phase cleanup. Not played mission wins, human enjoyment or hardware performance.
contracts: eight relative directions wrap across multiple rotations
charge outranks a resolved hit, which outranks recent fire
counts other broad directions rather than actors or duplicate thirty-degree groups
visible targets and direct objective bearings do not become offscreen/path callouts
an enemy hit by the player is distinguished from incoming damage
existing visor source grouping and focus remain representation inputs

checks: actual eligible rear charge is named; other alerted directions are counted
world cover still removes eligibility and visible targets retain optic brackets
resolved hit uses recorded source, rotates with view and expires without following shooter
Game recently-hit eligibility is labelled separately from incoming damage
recent fire expires through the existing Game alert window
real clear ground step has relative words and native turnaround updates them
far receiver button offers the selected walking route
compass, clock and both callouts fit below primary controls and above boss status
native map and pause clear cue presentation without catch-up alerts
